summary: Using postgres12_pgx driver with default_query_exec_mode: simple_protocol causes VisibilityCloseExecution to fail with a type conversion error on ExecutionDuration field.
userImpact: Users using postgres12_pgx with simple_protocol mode cannot close workflow executions; all closure attempts fail with type conversion errors.
rootCause: ExecutionDuration field is not properly cast to int64 when using simple_protocol query execution mode in PostgreSQL.
proposedFix: Cast ExecutionDuration to int64 in common/persistence/sql/sqlplugin/postgresql/visibility.go at line 161
